description: This Java source file defines the class RefreshOtaFilesRequest, which extends the Request class. It includes a constructor to initialize the request with an ID, and overrides the execute method to send a response and invoke the refreshOtaFiles method on the MockZigbeeCore singleton instance.

classes.name: RefreshOtaFilesRequest
classes.description: A class representing a request to refresh OTA files, extending the base Request class. It constructs the request with an ID and, upon execution, sends a response and triggers the OTA files refresh on the core.
